name: codex-tool-compatibility
goal: Prove desktop-bundled Codex can stream a Claude answer and execute its correlated read-only tool calls with namespace definitions.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Actual Codex 0.160.0 requests contain namespace tools and hosted web_search. Flat-only mapping rejected namespaces. Claude trial must disable unsupported hosted web search explicitly; catalog must disable Responses Lite so real tool calls remain structured.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: vitest run test/utils/gateway-tool-definitions.test.ts test/codex-namespaces.test.ts failed 3 unchanged assertions: namespace flattening, rejection of hosted tools and namespace preservation in function calls.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added namespace flattening and retained namespace on correlated outgoing function calls; unknown hosted tools still fail closed. Local trial config disables web_search and Responses Lite, uses owner-only command-backed auth, preserves native OpenAI default, and has a backup.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same 3 namespace assertions passed unchanged. Desktop-bundled CLI with installed trial profile performed /bin/zsh cat marker.txt under read-only sandbox and returned a previously unknown random marker. An earlier text-only catalog attempt was correctly rejected as evidence despite exit zero.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
